ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Apple vinegar is made by fermentation using apple juice as the raw material. Answer the following question: The respiratory metabolic pathway of yeast is shown in the figure. In what place in the yeast cell does process ③ in the figure take place?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: On the left side of the figure is “glucose”, which generates the intermediate “pyruvate” through process ①; pyruvate has two metabolic routes, one generating “ethanol + CO₂” through process ②, and the other generating “H₂O + CO₂” through process ③. Then reason: Process ③ indicates that pyruvate is completely oxidized and decomposed, ultimately generating carbon dioxide and water; this is the later stage of aerobic respiration in yeast. Yeast is a eukaryote, and the main place where pyruvate is further oxidized and decomposed in its aerobic respiration is the mitochondria. Therefore process ③ takes place in the mitochondria of yeast cells.
